lines.text: The writer calls everyone to test their ways, turn back to the LORD, and confess they have sinned and rebelled.
The writer says God covered Himself with a cloud no prayer can pass through and made them scum among the nations.
Without cause his enemies hunted him like a bird and dropped him alive into a den of lions.
Out of the Pit the writer called on the LORD's name, and the LORD drew near and said, "Be still and wait."
The writer says the LORD will pay his enemies back according to the work of their hands and pursue them in anger.
